# TeeToTum

> no_std Rust firmware with esp-hal for the Waveshare ESP32-S3 1.8" Knob Display: a round 360x360 screen with a rotary knob, a haptic motor and a second microcontroller for Bluetooth audio. The firmware is a ring menu turned with the knob, plus a host for plugins — small WebAssembly modules, run under wasmi, that get a screen of their own.

A hobby project and a work in progress; `teetotum-face` and `teetotum-pack` are on crates.io at 0.1, and interfaces may still change between minor versions. Licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.

The workspace has five parts: `teetotum/` (the library: screen, touch, knob, settings store, menu), `firmware/` (the binary, the plugin loader and the measurement programs in `firmware/src/bin/`), `teetotum-face/` (the plugin SDK with the `face!` macro), `teetotum-pack/` (signature checks shared by the firmware and the host tool that signs and packs plugins) and `plugins/` (example plugins).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/teetotum-rs/firmware/blob/main/README.md): what the firmware does today, building and flashing, layout, what you can break
- [User guide](https://github.com/teetotum-rs/firmware/blob/main/docs/user-guide.md): the controls, Home, the Music Player, Card over Wi-Fi (the TF card read-only from a browser), every setting, troubleshooting, installing from the browser, building and flashing
- [Web installer](https://teetotum-rs.github.io/firmware/): writes the latest release from desktop Chrome, Edge or Opera, no toolchain
- [Plugin page](https://teetotum-rs.github.io/firmware/plugins.html): sends a signed plugin to a knob over Web Bluetooth, from the catalogue of teetotum-rs/plugins or a local file
- [Using plugins](https://github.com/teetotum-rs/firmware/blob/main/docs/plugins.md): the bundled plugins, plugin settings, rights, memory and limits, installing more over Bluetooth or USB
- [Writing plugins](https://github.com/teetotum-rs/firmware/blob/main/docs/plugin-development.md): the teetotum-face SDK, the manifest, events, drawing, host calls, resource limits, building and bundling
- [Code quality](https://github.com/teetotum-rs/firmware/blob/main/docs/code-quality.md): the checks a push must pass — rustfmt, Clippy with every warning an error, the stack-frame lint, exceptions with a reason, the pre-push hook
- [Changelog](https://github.com/teetotum-rs/firmware/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed for users and plugin authors, release by release

## Code

- [Plugin SDK](https://github.com/teetotum-rs/firmware/tree/main/teetotum-face): the crate a plugin depends on
- [Plugin tool](https://github.com/teetotum-rs/firmware/tree/main/teetotum-pack): checks, signs and packs a plugin
- [Example plugins](https://github.com/teetotum-rs/firmware/tree/main/plugins): templates to start a plugin from
- [Plugin repository](https://github.com/teetotum-rs/plugins): the cargo-generate template for a new plugin and the index of known plugins
- [Plugin loader](https://github.com/teetotum-rs/firmware/blob/main/firmware/src/plugin.rs): how the firmware checks, loads and runs a plugin
